name: Prancing Pony
description: The inn at the edge of town, where adventurers come to hear of work, and to take the jobs pinned to its notice board.

name: sealed door
description: A great door of dark stone, carved with dwarven runes and fast shut. No pick or spell will move it; it was made to open for one key alone.

name: barrow altar
description: A low altar of cracked stone, cold to the touch. Whatever was hallowed here was long ago profaned.

name: dwarven forge
description: An ancient forge of the Naugrim, its fire still burning in the rock. Here things of power were made, and here they may be unmade.

name: hermit's door
description: A narrow door in the rock, a lamp burning behind it. Someone lives down here, and has for a long time.

name: trapped apprentice
description: A young man pinned in a hollow of fallen rock, a basket of cave-moss clutched to his chest. He's been down here too long.

name: cold brazier
description: A great iron brazier on a stone foot, full of cold black ash. It was kept burning once.

name: burning brazier
description: A great iron brazier, burning high and bright with a fire that throws the shadows back.

name: merchant caravan
description: A painted wagon and a striped awning in the town square: a merchant from far away, here a few days with rare goods at travellers' prices.

name: Arcane Artificer
description: A narrow workshop of glass and brass, where SlatriBartSlow cuts sockets for gems into armour and blades — for a great deal of gold.

name: lamp post
description: An iron lamp post, its lamp lit at dusk by the town's lamplighter. The town put it up with what your deeds brought in.

name: well
description: A stone well with a little roof over it and a bucket on a rope, newly dug. The water is cold and sweet.

name: market stall
description: A trestle under a striped awning, piled with apples, cheeses and bolts of cloth. Market days are back in town.

name: fountain
description: A fountain at the heart of the square, its basin carved with leaves and its water bright. Children dare each other to wade in it.

name: statue
description: A statue raised in the square in honour of the adventurer who made the town safe again. It is a fair likeness, mostly.

name: message scratched into the floor
description: A few words scratched into the stone of the floor by someone who fell near here. Step on them, or look at them, to read them.

name: shrine of Elbereth
description: A small white altar under a carving of seven stars, softly shining. It is hallowed to Elbereth, Varda the Star-kindler, whose name the orcs fear.

name: shrine of Aulë
description: An anvil-shaped altar of grey stone, a hammer cut deep in its face and a forge-glow in the rock behind it. It is hallowed to Aulë the Smith, maker of the Dwarves.

name: shrine of Yavanna
description: A low altar overgrown with moss and small flowers that should not grow so far from the sun. It is hallowed to Yavanna, Giver of Fruits.

name: shrine of Mandos
description: A grey altar, cold and still, carved with a hooded figure and long lists of names. It is hallowed to Mandos, the Doomsman of the Valar, keeper of the Houses of the Dead.

name: dark altar of Morgoth
description: An altar of black iron, crowned with spikes and stained with old offerings. It is raised to Morgoth, the Black Foe of the World. His gifts are great, and his price is greater.

name: darkened altar
description: An altar gone dark and cold. Whatever power heeded prayers here has turned its face away.
